description: This PHP source file defines the AttendanceConfiguration class within the OrangeHRM Attendance module. It contains private boolean properties indicating user permissions related to attendance management, along with corresponding getter and setter methods.

classes.name: AttendanceConfiguration
classes.description: Data Transfer Object (DTO) class representing user permission configurations for attendance management within the OrangeHRM Attendance module.

methods.name: canUserChangeCurrentTime
methods.description: Getter method that returns whether the user can change the current time.

methods.name: setCanUserChangeCurrentTime
methods.description: Setter method to set whether the user can change the current time.

methods.name: canUserModifyAttendance
methods.description: Getter method that returns whether the user can modify attendance.

methods.name: setCanUserModifyAttendance
methods.description: Setter method to set whether the user can modify attendance.

methods.name: canSupervisorModifyAttendance
methods.description: Getter method that returns whether a supervisor can modify attendance.

methods.name: setCanSupervisorModifyAttendance
methods.description: Setter method to set whether a supervisor can modify attendance.
